documents: Self-help group membership certificate, if applying through a group
Identity proof (Aadhaar card or voter ID)
Address proof
Recent passport-size photographs
Bank account passbook or cancelled cheque
Caste or community certificate, where the scheme targets a category
Income certificate
Project report with project cost and repayment plan
Quotations for machinery, equipment or animals to be purchased
steps: Confirm the business activity and the available margin money (your own contribution).
Check the scheme tier: the project cost decides whether the Micro Finance Scheme or the Term Loan Scheme applies.
Prepare a simple project report with the project cost, the capital expenditure and working capital split, and the repayment schedule.
Collect the required documents and self-attest the copies.
Complete the loan application form and submit it with the documents to the channelising agency or lending bank.
Attend verification: the agency checks the documents, may visit the business site and appraises the project report.
Receive the sanction letter stating the approved loan amount and terms.
Deposit or show proof of your margin contribution and sign the loan agreement.
Receive disbursement, usually paid directly to suppliers or into your bank account in stages.
Start repayment after the moratorium; keep receipts for every installment.
